# E0365: a lens writes a constraint where an instance needs a value

A lens writes a constraint, such as `int` or a disjunction, where an instance
needs one concrete value. The result would not be an instance of the target.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: string
				n: int
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		v0_0: _
		v1_0: {
			a: v0_0.a
			n: int
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		v1_0: _
		v0_0: {
			a: v1_0.a
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0365]: n in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is int, a constraint rather than a value; a result field must have a concrete value
  --> lineage.cue:24:4
   |
24 |             n: int
   |             ^
   |
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule not-a-value)
```
